pages.text: I can raise an enormous oak directly from open ground.

$(bold)Mana:$() 2 buckets$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Instant$(br2)Aim at ground within eight blocks with at least eighteen blocks of replaceable vertical clearance. The spell procedurally creates a thirteen-to-seventeen-block drifting trunk, lower trunk thickness, four large branches, and irregular leaf crowns.
